record.title: Nephrotic syndrome caused by Babesia spp. in a dog: A case repor
record.journal: Repositorio Institucional Universidad del Tolima (Universidad del Tolima)

screening.rationale: Title and OpenAlex metadata only (Guerra, Ardila and López, Universidad del Tolima repository, pp. 91-99, 2012); the repository page is behind a bot check. A case report of nephrotic syndrome would be a distinct renal syndrome, but the diagnosis, the evidence, the peer-review status and the original publication date cannot be checked.
